prompt: Same user prompt and chat template as shared boxed protocol
generation: One uninterrupted native sequence until model EOS or total budget; no forced thinking close or answer cue
sampling: FP16 SDPA, T=.6 top_p=.95 top_k=20, hash uniforms in think phase for whole native sequence
scoring: Apply frozen v3 scorer only to text after first native thinking close. Unclosed thinking receives no final-answer credit. Censored complete answers and EOS-complete outputs reported separately.
comparison_scope: Readout protocol sensitivity only. Total token cap equals nominal thought cap plus192; native answer allocation is not separately capped. Do not pool with forced-reader performance.
execution_dependency: After real budget and crossed-noise jobs finish; no GPU contention with measured requests
